target.statement: Selective p-value (direction-conditioned, Theorem 1) for testing equality of slopes between two k-means-selected groups in a simulated panel, e.g. the Type I error / power cell for DGP1 at (N,T)=(60,15) or (120,25)
target.dataset: synthetic panel data generated from DGP1 (Su et al. 2016 / Liu et al. 2020 style)

code_links: R package TestHomoPanel (named in abstract; no URL given in PDF)

compute.basis: Target is a simulation cell requiring re-implementing the k-means-on-initial-estimates clustering, the quadratic-inequality truncation set S, and truncated chi-square p-values from scratch (no code link in PDF), then running hundreds of replications; all CPU, small N*T data.

blockers: No code URL in the PDF; only a named R package TestHomoPanel whose availability/location is unverified
Core algorithm (truncation set S, quadratic inequality coefficients in Lemmas 1-2) must be re-implemented from the math
Monte Carlo less-conditioned p-value (Section 4) adds further implementation burden
title: Conditional Selective Inference for the Selected Groups in Panel Data
